The Bill was named after the victim of gang rape and murder in Hyderabad in 2019. The Bill had been awaiting assent from the Union Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA), which had raised various objections. items.summary: Read Revati Laul’s response to this piece: A friend of the victim of alleged sexual assault by Tarun Tejpal responds .
